readings.title: The God of the Exodus Arises
readings.subtitle: He scatters His enemies and cares for the lonely.
readings.text: [Psalm 68:1] <dn>Elohim</dn> arises, <dn>His</dn> enemies are scattered. And those who hate <dn>Him</dn> flee before <dn>Him</dn>! [2] As smoke is driven away, <dn>You</dn> drive them away; As wax melts before the fire, The wrong perish before <dn>Elohim</dn>. [3] But the righteous are glad, They exult before <dn>Elohim</dn>. And they rejoice with gladness. [4] Sing to <dn>Elohim</dn>, sing praises to <dn>His</dn> Name. Raise up a highway for <dn>Him</dn> Who rides through the deserts, By <dn>His</dn> Name <dn>Yah</dn>, And exult before <dn>Him</dn>. [5] Father of the fatherless, And Right-ruler of widows, Is <dn>Elohim</dn> in <dn>His</dn> set-apart dwelling. [6] <dn>Elohim</dn> makes a home for the lonely; <dn>He</dn> brings out into prosperity Those who are bound with chains; Only the rebellious shall dwell in a dry land.

readings.title: Recalling the March from Sinai
readings.subtitle: The earth shook and the heavens dropped before Elohim.
readings.text: [Psalm 68:7] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, when <dn>You</dn> went out before <dn>Your</dn> people, When <dn>You</dn> stepped through the wilderness, Selah. [8] The earth shook and the heavens dropped before <dn>Elohim</dn>, This Sinai, shook before <dn>Elohim</dn>, the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl. [9] <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, sent a shower of plenty, <dn>You</dn> confirmed <dn>Your</dn> inheritance, When it was weary. [10] <dn>Your</dn> flock dwelt in it; <dn>You</dn> provided from <dn>Your</dn> goodness for the poor, O <dn>Elohim</dn>. [11] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gave <dn>את</dn> the word; The women who proclaimed it was a great company: [12] <dq>“Sovereigns of armies flee in haste! And she who remains at home divides the spoil.”</dq> [13] If you lie down among the sheepfolds, The wings of a dove are covered with silver, And her feathers with yellow gold. [14] When the Almighty scattered sovereigns in it, It did snow in Tsalmon.

readings.title: The Mountain of God's Dwelling
readings.subtitle: You have ascended on high, leading captivity captive.
readings.text: [Psalm 68:15] A mountain of <dn>Elohim</dn> is the mountain of Bashan; A mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan. [16] O mountain of peaks, why do you gaze in envy At the mountain which <dn>Elohim</dn> desired to dwell in; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> even dwells there forever. [17] The chariots of <dn>Elohim</dn> are twenty thousand, Thousands of thousands; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came from Sinai Into the Set-apart Place. [18] <dn>You</dn> have ascended on high, <dn>You</dn> have led captivity captive, <dn>You</dn> have received gifts among men, And even the rebellious, That <dn>Yah</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> might dwell there. [19] Blessed be <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Day by day <dn>He</dn> bears our burden, The <dn>Ěl</dn> of our deliverance! Selah. [20] Our <dn>Ěl</dn> is the <dn>Ěl</dn> of deliverance; And to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the <dn>Master</dn>, belong escapes from death. [21] Indeed, <dn>Elohim</dn> smites <dn>את</dn> the head of <dn>His</dn> enemies, The hairy scalp of him who walks about in <dn>His</dn> guilt. [22] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> bring back from Bashan, <dn>I</dn> bring back from the depths of the sea,</dq> [23] <dq>“So that you plunge your foot in blood; That the tongues of your dogs Have their portion from the enemies.”</dq>

readings.title: A Call for Universal Praise
readings.subtitle: Sing to Elohim, you reigns of the earth.
readings.text: [Psalm 68:24] They have seen <dn>Your</dn> goings, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, The goings of my <dn>Ěl</dn>, my Sovereign, Into the set-apart place. [25] The singers went in front, The players on instruments after them; Among them were the young women playing tambourines. [26] Bless <dn>Elohim</dn> in the assemblies, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, from the fountain of Yisra’ěl. [27] There is Binyamin, the smallest, their ruler, The leaders of Yehuḏah, their company, The leader of Zeḇulun, the leader of Naphtali. [28] <dn>Your</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> has commanded your strength, be strong! O <dn>Elohim</dn>, this <dn>You</dn> have worked out for us! [29] Because of <dn>Your</dn> Hěḵal at Yerushalayim, Sovereigns bring presents to <dn>You</dn>. [30] Rebuke the wild beasts of the reeds, The herd of bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Each one humbling himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the peoples who delight in conflicts! [31] Ambassadors come out of Mitsrayim; Kush stretches out her hands to <dn>Elohim</dn>. [32] Sing to <dn>Elohim</dn>, you reigns of the earth, Praises to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Selah. [33] To <dn>Him</dn> who rides on the ancient highest heavens! See, <dn>He</dn> sends out <dn>His</dn> voice, a mighty voice. [34] Ascribe strength to <dn>Elohim</dn>; <dn>His</dn> excellence is over Yisra’ěl, And <dn>His</dn> strength is in the clouds. [35] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, awesome from <dn>Your</dn> set-apart places, The <dn>Ěl</dn> of Yisra’ěl is <dn>He</dn> Who gives strength and power to <dn>His</dn> people. Blessed be <dn>Elohim</dn>!

readings.title: Sinking in Deep Mire
readings.subtitle: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head.
readings.text: [Psalm 69:1] Save me, O <dn>Elohim</dn>! For waters have come up to my neck. [2] <dn>I</dn> have sunk in deep mud, And there is no place to stand; <dn>I</dn> have come into deep waters, And the floods overflow me. [3] <dn>I</dn> am worn out from my crying; <dn>My</dn> throat is dry; <dn>My</dn> eyes grow dim As <dn>I</dn> wait for my <dn>Elohim</dn>. [4] Those who hate me without a cause Are more than the hairs of my head; They are mighty who would destroy me, <dn>My</dn> lying enemies; What <dn>I</dn> did not steal, <dn>I</dn> restored. [5] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>You</dn> <dn>Yourself</dn> know my foolishness; And my guilt has not been hidden from <dn>You</dn>. [6] Let not those who wait for <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>Master</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, Be ashamed because of me; Let not those who seek <dn>You</dn> Be humbled because of me, O <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl. [7] Because <dn>I</dn> have borne reproach for <dn>Your</dn> sake; Shame has covered my face. [8] <dn>I</dn> have become a stranger to my brothers, And a foreigner to my mother’s children; [9] Because ardour for <dn>Your</dn> house has eaten me up, And <dn>את</dn> the reproaches of those who reproach <dn>You</dn> have fallen on me. [10] And <dn>I</dn> wept in my being with fasting, And it became my reproach. [11] And when <dn>I</dn> put on sackcloth, <dn>I</dn> became a proverb to them. [12] They who sit in the gate talk about me, And <dn>I</dn> am the song of the drunkards.

readings.title: A Prayer for Rescue
readings.subtitle: They gave me gall for my food and vinegar for my thirst.
readings.text: [Psalm 69:13] But as for me, my prayer is to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, At an acceptable time, O <dn>Elohim</dn>. In the greatness of <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, Answer me in the truth of <dn>Your</dn> deliverance. [14] Rescue me out of the mire, And let me not sink. Let me be rescued from those who hate me, And out of the deep waters. [15] Let not a flood of waters overflow me, Nor let the deep swallow me up, Nor let the pit shut its mouth on me. [16] Answer me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment is good. According to the greatness of <dn>Your</dn> compassion, turn to me. [17] And do not hide <dn>Your</dn> face from <dn>Your</dn> servant, For <dn>I</dn> am in distress; Answer me speedily. [18] Draw near to my being, redeem it; Ransom me because of my enemies. [19] <dn>You</dn> <dn>Yourself</dn> know my reproach, And my shame and my confusion; <dn>My</dn> adversaries are all before <dn>You</dn>. [20] Reproach has broken my heart and <dn>I</dn> am sick; <dn>I</dn> looked for sympathy, but there was none; And for comforters, but <dn>I</dn> found none. [21] And they gave me gall for my food, And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

readings.title: Imprecation Against Enemies
readings.subtitle: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living.
readings.text: [Psalm 69:22] Let their table before them become a snare, And a trap to those at ease. [23] Let their eyes be darkened, so as not to see; And make their loins shake continually. [24] Pour out <dn>Your</dn> wrath upon them, And let <dn>Your</dn> burning displeasure overtake them. [25] Let their encampments be deserted; Let no one dwell in their tents. [26] For they persecute him whom <dn>You</dn> have stricken, And talk about the pain of those <dn>You</dn> have wounded. [27] Add crookedness to their crookedness, And let them not enter into <dn>Your</dn> righteousness. [28] Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with <dn>את</dn> the righteous.

readings.title: A Vow of Praise and Hope for Zion
readings.subtitle: Elohim shall save Tsiyon and build the cities of Yehuḏah.
readings.text: [Psalm 69:29] But <dn>I</dn> am poor and in pain; Let <dn>Your</dn> deliverance, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, set me up on high. [30] <dn>I</dn> praise the Name of <dn>Elohim</dn> with a song, And <dn>I</dn> make <dn>Him</dn> great with thanksgiving. [31] And this pleases <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> more than an ox, A bull with horns and hooves. [32] The humble shall see, they rejoice, You who seek <dn>Elohim</dn>, and your hearts live. [33] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> hears the poor, And <dn>He</dn> shall not despise <dn>His</dn> captives. [34] Let the heavens and earth praise <dn>Him</dn>, The seas and all that moves in them. [35] For <dn>Elohim</dn> shall save Tsiyon And build the cities of Yehuḏah. And they shall dwell there and possess it, [36] And the seed of <dn>His</dn> servants inherit it, And those who love <dn>His</dn> Name dwell in it.

readings.title: Hasten to My Help
readings.subtitle: You are my help and my deliverer; O YeHoVaH, do not delay.
readings.text: [Psalm 70:1] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, deliver me! Hasten to my help, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! [2] Let those who seek my life Be ashamed and abashed, Let those who are desiring my evil Be turned back and humiliated. [3] Let those who say, “Aha, aha!” Be turned back because of their shame. [4] Let all those who seek <dn>You</dn> Rejoice and be glad in <dn>You</dn>; And let those who love <dn>Your</dn> deliverance always say, “Let <dn>Elohim</dn> be made great!” [5] But <dn>I</dn> am poor and needy; Hasten to me, O <dn>Elohim</dn>! <dn>You</dn> are my help and my deliverer; O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, do not delay.

readings.title: Incline Your Ear, O YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: In the day of my distress I call upon You, for You answer me.
readings.text: [Psalm 86:1] Incline <dn>Your</dn> ear, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Answer me, for <dn>I</dn> am poor and needy. [2] Guard my being, for <dn>I</dn> am lovingly-committed; <dn>You</dn> are my <dn>Elohim</dn>; Save <dn>Your</dn> servant who is trusting in <dn>You</dn>! [3] Show favour to me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For <dn>I</dn> cry to <dn>You</dn> all day long. [4] Bring joy to the being of <dn>Your</dn> servant, For to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> lift up my being. [5] For <dn>You</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, are good, and ready to forgive, And great in loving-commitment to all those who call upon <dn>You</dn>. [6] Give ear, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to my prayer; And listen to the voice of my pleadings. [7] In the day of my distress <dn>I</dn> call upon <dn>You</dn>, For <dn>You</dn> answer me.

readings.title: Teach Me Your Way
readings.subtitle: Unite my heart to fear Your Name.
readings.text: [Psalm 86:8] There is none like <dn>You</dn> among the mighty ones, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; And like <dn>Your</dn> works there are none. [9] Let all nations <dn>You</dn> have made Come and bow themselves before <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And give esteem to <dn>Your</dn> Name. [10] For <dn>You</dn> are great, and are doing wonders; <dn>You</dn> are <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>You</dn> alone. [11] Teach me <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> way, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Let me walk in <dn>Your</dn> truth; Unite <dn>את</dn> my heart to fear <dn>Your</dn> Name. [12] <dn>I</dn> praise <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn>, with all my heart, And <dn>I</dn> esteem <dn>Your</dn> Name forever. [13] For <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment is great toward me, And <dn>You</dn> have delivered my being From the depths of She’ol. [14] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, the proud have risen against me, And a band of dreaded men have sought my life, And have not set <dn>You</dn> before them. [15] But <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Are a compassionate <dn>Ěl</dn> and showing favour, Patient and great in loving-commitment and truth. [16] Turn to me, and show favour to me! Give <dn>Your</dn> strength to <dn>Your</dn> servant, And save the son of <dn>Your</dn> female servant. [17] Show me a sign for good, And let those hating me see it and be ashamed, For <dn>You</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have helped me and comforted me.

readings.title: A Vow of Integrity
readings.subtitle: I walk in the midst of my house with a perfect heart.
readings.text: [Psalm 101:1] <dn>I</dn> sing of loving-commitment and right-ruling; To <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> sing praises. [2] <dn>I</dn> act wisely in a perfect way. When do <dn>You</dn> come to me? <dn>I</dn> walk in the midst of my house with a perfect heart. [3] <dn>I</dn> set no matter of Beliya‛al before my eyes; <dn>I</dn> hate <dn>את</dn> the work of those who fall away; It does not cleave to me. [4] A perverse heart turns away from me; <dn>I</dn> do not know evil. [5] Him who secretly slanders his neighbour <dn>I</dn> cut off; <dn>I</dn> do not tolerate <dn>את</dn> one Who has a haughty look and a proud heart. [6] <dn>My</dn> eyes are on the trustworthy of the land, To dwell with me; He who walks in a perfect way, He serves me. [7] He who practises deceit Does not dwell in my house; He who speaks lies Does not stand in my presence. [8] Each morning <dn>I</dn> uproot <dn>את</dn> all the wrong of the land, To cut off <dn>את</dn> all the workers of wickedness From the city of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
